Monster from Diablo II Resurrected. 20 different poses with some additional weapon options, including Shadowfang to portray Fleshdoom from the first game's cut content (later reintroduced by mods like Belzebub).
Also includes some massive axe wielding specimen in case you wanted a proxy for a certain notorious bloodthirsty demon.

Each pose has a wingless version and there are four different separate wings provided, each with two attachment angle options. Beware, the fit of separate wings is going to be loose and fiddly, with lots of sanding and gap filling. For a larger print I strongly suggest pinning the wings as well.

Separate armored codpiece is supplied as well.
